title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-19
content:
2026-03-19 - serving-runtime daily scratchpad
Owner: Evelyn Chen (eng-serving-runtime)
Collaborators pinged: Raj, Maya

Quick context:
- Focus for this sprint: reduce tail latency for small-chat workloads + stabilize KV cache under aggressive batching.
- Running into sporadic 95p spikes on p3-small equivalent nodes; suspected kernel/GEMM scheduling interactions when sequence lengths > 512.

Morning triage (what I looked at):
- INF-777: reproducible 95p spike when batch size > 16 + use_quant=true + seq_len_dist skewed (some long requests).
  - Repro steps (local): run loadgen with --seq-mix "128:0.6,512:0.3,1024:0.1" and batching policy continuous_batched
  - Observed: KV cache miss storm triggers fallback path; CPU pins spike, GPU utilization drops to 20-30% while latency jumps.
  - Hypothesis: cache eviction path serializes some host-side work; also GEMM kernel selection on profiler shows fall back to non-fused matmul for certain shapes.

Immediate actions taken:
- Rolled back PR from yesterday (PR 842) on canary to stop the regression; canary latency normalized.
- Added extra logging around cache eviction and fallback path (small, low-overhead counters).
- Reproduced locally and captured nvprof traces and serving logs (uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-debug/evict-traces/2026-03-19/).

Open bugs / notes to file tickets: (will file after sync)
- BUG: eviction-serialization (INF-789) - eviction path holds global lock causing host blocking under heavy miss rates. Priority: high.
- BUG: kernel-fallback-path (INF-790) - matmul selection falls back unexpectedly for shape N=1,K=4096 even when fused kernel available. Priority: medium-high.

Perf TODOs (experiments to run):
- [ ] Experiment A: disable eviction immediate flush; instead mark to background thread and measure 95p. Steps: instrument background eviction queue, run loadgen with same seq mix.
- [ ] Experiment B: force fused GEMM selection for suspect shapes in local build (toggle via env VAR KERNEL_OVERRIDE=force_fused) and retest.
- [ ] Run microbench: single-request large seq (1024) throughput/latency vs many small concurrent (bs=1 x 256) to see scheduling impact.
- [ ] Smoke test different batching policies: continuous_batched vs fixed-window (window=8ms) to compare tail.

Kernel-level notes (scratch):
- On profiler: check whether cuBLAS is being used or our custom fused kernels. The fallback logs show "no_fused_match -> schedule_cublas". Need to capture kernel names from NVTX ranges.
- Check code path: src/kernels/selector.cc line ~312 (recent refactor) — Raj touched this last week in PR#836. Possible regression in shape hash.

Commands / quick snippets I ran:
- reproduce locally:
  ./tools/loadgen --model ggml-16b --policy continuous_batched --batch-max 32 --seq-mix "128:0.6,512:0.3,1024:0.1" --duration 600 --out s3://redwood-debug/evict-traces/2026-03-19/
- capture trace:
  NVTX_ENABLE=1 ./bazel-bin/serving/runtime --config=local_trace --trace-out=trace-evict-0319.nvprof

Notes from brief sync with Raj (10:30am):
- Raj: eviction code currently uses coarse-grained lock to simplify correctness; he's going to prototype a lock-free queue for background eviction.
- Plan: Raj to push small patch that moves eviction to background thread (no opaque API changes) so we can try canary. He expects 1-2 days for prototype + perf run.

Patch status / PRs to watch:
- PR 842 (reverted on canary) - reverted by me this morning; need follow-up that reintroduces changes with eviction fix.
- PR 836 (kernel selector refactor) - landed last week; check for shape-hash logic.

Meeting notes / follow-ups:
- 14:00 sync with SRE + infra to discuss node sizing for dedicated pools; bring perf numbers and trace. (Agenda: short-term mitigation vs config + longer-term kernel/fusion work)
- TODO: prepare short artifact (2 slides) showing before/after latency and nvprof captures for infra sync.

Personal TODO (today):
- [ ] File INF-789 and INF-790 with logs + steps + attach trace (deadline today EOD).
- [ ] Run Experiment A & B locally and upload results.
- [ ] Draft two-slide summary for 14:00 (use existing dashboard screenshots).
- [ ] Follow up with Maya on quantization profile tests for 8-bit path (she's running 4 configs).

Misc / random notes:
- Consider adding a low-overhead eviction metric to console (eviction_rate, eviction_block_ms) so product can correlate regressions quickly.
- If background eviction reduces 95p significantly, consider defaulting to background mode for hosted API where isolation is limited.

End-of-day plan:
- Consolidate experiment outputs and open tickets. If we have clear improvement from background eviction, schedule canary for tomorrow morning.

----
Raw/log pointers:
- s3://redwood-debug/evict-traces/2026-03-19/ (nvprof, logs, flamegraphs)
- GH PR 842: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/842
- JIRA INF-777 (original regression report)

Notes-to-self: keep it lightweight, jot results inline here tomorrow morning for continuity.
